title: Refinement carrying a descent datum
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $k_s$ a separable closure, and $K\subseteq k_s$ a finite separable intermediate field. Let $J_K$ be a finitely presented, quasi-separated $K$-scheme, and let $J_s$ be a $k_s$-scheme with a specified cartesian map $q:J_s\to J_K$ [def-pc-base-change]. Given a descent datum $E$ on $J_s$ relative to $\operatorname{Spec}(k_s)\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ [def-pd-descent-datum], there are a finite separable intermediate field $L$ containing $K$, a cartesian refinement $r:J_L\to J_K$, a cartesian map $q_L:J_s\to J_L$, and a descent datum $D$ on $J_L$ relative to $\operatorname{Spec}(L)\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ such that $r\circ q_L=q$ and the base change of $D$ is $E$.

proof.text:
Enlarge a finite separable model to carry a descended transport datum.

Proof: spread the universal transport morphism over the double base product. It is natural
 by pullback functoriality. The identity and cocycle equations are checked after successively
 lifting the one or three base maps along `Spec ks → Spec L`. These pullbacks are faithfully
 flat, hence epimorphisms, so their cancellation proves the equations over `L` itself.

Source: Stacks Project, Tags 01ZM (2), 023V and 02VW.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteSeparable_descentDatum_refinement {k ks : Type u} [Field k] [Field ks] [Algebra k ks] [IsSepClosure k ks] (K : IntermediateField k ks) [FiniteDimensional k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K] (JK : Over (Spec (.of K))) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation JK.hom] [QuasiCompact JK.hom] [QuasiSeparated JK.hom] (Js : Over (Spec (.of ks))) (q : Js.left ⟶ JK.left) (hq : IsPullback q Js.hom JK.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K ks)))) (E : Over.DescentDatum (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k ks))) Js) : ∃ (L : IntermediateField k ks), FiniteDimensional k L ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable k L ∧ ∃ (hKL : K ≤ L) (JL : Over (Spec (.of L))) (r : JL.left ⟶ JK.left), IsPullback r JL.hom JK.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IntermediateField.inclusion hKL).toRingHom)) ∧ ∃ (qL : Js.left ⟶ JL.left) (hqL : IsPullback qL Js.hom JL.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L ks)))) (D : Over.DescentDatum (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))) JL), qL ≫ r = q ∧ D.IsBaseChange (by rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]) hqL.w E
